The X-ray showing dilated bowel loops with no gas in the rectum, combined with the infant's failure to pass meconium and bilious vomiting, strongly suggests a distal intestinal obstruction. Given the history, this is most consistent with Hirschsprung's disease rather than a simple ileal atresia.
